title: Outstanding Oven Glazed Vietnamese Chicken Drumsticks Skewers
description: A winey and bouncy Vietnamese dish featuring chicken drumsticks in a sweet and sticky glaze, perfect for a show-off dinner party
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, honey, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, black pepper, and salt.
Add the chicken drumsticks to the bowl and toss to coat with the glaze.
Thread the chicken drumsticks onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
Arrange the skewers on the baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake for 25 minutes, then brush with the remaining glaze.
Continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and caramelized.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
